title: Copilot Studio: web browsing for agents on the Microsoft Copilot harness
summary: Hold: the environment credit-control instructions omit Microsoft's published environment-group policy exception. When that policy governs tenant-pool draw, the environment setting is read-only and API updates are rejected; administrators must change the group rule or remove the environment from the group first. The roadmap facts and the distinction from standard-harness computer use are supported.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; controls[0]
claims.claim: Administrators can clear tenant-pool draw at environment level or update it programmatically without a group-policy qualification.
claims.quote: If a published environment group rule governs Draw from the available capacity in my tenant, you can't override the setting for an individual environment.
claims.fix: Qualify the environment instructions and controls[0].note: if a published environment-group rule governs tenant-pool draw, the environment setting is read-only and API/SDK updates fail with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy. Change and republish the group rule, or remove the environment from the group, before changing the environment setting. After removal it retains the group's last value. The cited tutorial and harness cost guide both document this.
